_comment: What the ranked file finder searches. Read by lua/ulvim/search and scripts/search-index.ts. Put your own roots in search-roots.local.json (same shape), which wins when it exists. projects are searched as one tree each; every child folder of a container is its own project; folders that do not exist are skipped. Git repos list their own files (git ls-files), so build output and caches a repo does not track never appear. excludes are folder names nobody edits by hand, applied everywhere.
